newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR ENDS SLIGHLY EASIER ON KEY UNITS.
newsitem.headline: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR ENDS SLIGHLY EASIER ON KEY UNITS.

text.p: The Zimbabwe dollar ended the week slightly easier on key currencies on Friday with foreign exchange dealers saying there were a few payments as players squared up their positions ahead of the weekend.
"The dollar went down a bit as there were a few payments in the market and people were squaring up their positions before the weekend. But it wasn't anything much," one dealer said.
At Friday's close, the local unit was quoted against the U.S. dollar at 10.3650/3850, a tad weaker from its 10.3625/3825 late Thursday position.
It was indicated at 16.2210/2630 on sterling from 16.2140/2540 and at 6.7810/7970 on the mark compared to 6.7670/7820 but firmed marginally to 2.2820/2630 on the rand versus 2.2880/2940.
